# Harry Winter

> Harry Winter (Harry P. Winter) is a second-year Information Management for Business student at University College London (UCL), based in London, UK. He builds software projects in Python, SQL and TypeScript, focused on algorithmic trading, prediction markets and tools for debugging AI agents.

## Key facts

- Name: Harry Winter (also written Harry P. Winter)
- Education: BSc Information Management for Business, University College London (UCL), second year, on track for a First
- Location: London, United Kingdom
- Skills: Python, SQL, TypeScript, data analysis, pandas, SQLite, OpenTelemetry
- Interests: algorithmic trading, prediction markets, LLM agent tooling
- Looking for: internships and placements in London (data, quant, AI tooling)
- Website: https://harrywinter06-code.github.io/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/harry-p-winter

## Projects

- [Autonomous Trading System](https://harrywinter06-code.github.io/projects/trading-system/): Harry Winter's autonomous trading pipeline in Python: evolutionary strategy search, regime classification, walk-forward validation and Alpaca paper trading. Code: https://github.com/harrywinter06-code/Trading-system
- [clustertrace](https://harrywinter06-code.github.io/projects/clustertrace/): clustertrace by Harry Winter: a local-first debugger that clusters LLM agent traces by execution pattern so failures surface. SQLite, OpenTelemetry, MCP. Code: https://github.com/harrywinter06-code/clustertrace
- [polymarket-edge](https://harrywinter06-code.github.io/projects/polymarket-edge/): Harry Winter's Polymarket negRisk arbitrage scanner and Hyperliquid funding backtest, with depth-aware fills, walk-forward tests and bootstrap CIs. Code: https://github.com/harrywinter06-code/polymarket-edge
- [gina-starter-pack](https://harrywinter06-code.github.io/projects/gina-starter-pack/): Harry Winter's three Polymarket negRisk strategy packs for Ask Gina: basket arbitrage, maker yield and a longshot-bias study, with risk-gated executors. Code: https://github.com/harrywinter06-code/gina-starter-pack
